ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 晚上好，我们是millsage！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 晚上好，我们是millsage！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 嗯，拜拜！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……你好，小萤

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
哇～真是的，大家不用管我啦！
辛苦了，回见！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
这样啊……抱歉吓到你了吧。
这个视频最近在社交网站上挺火的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 嗯。谢谢你

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 都说了对不起啦～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊，不是的，不是这样！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 你是……视频里的那个女孩，对吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊，果然是有人擅自传上去的……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 所以我有些在意，就来看看你……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 但我认为，现在正是我们新的起点

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
那个……你经常在这里弹钢琴吗？
弹得特别好呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
你看，就是这个视频。
那个『神秘的超强街头钢琴少女』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 她真的在弹……millsage的曲子……！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
这样啊。那可能最好找个懂这方面的人，
问问怎么申请删除比较好

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
啊，突然搭话真不好意思……我叫滨崎茉幌。
在水濑女子学园高中部读2年级哦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 那、那个。其实我——

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
还称不上认识……只是前几天，
小萤弹钢琴的时候我过去搭了个话

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
不愧是小枣！
我也要加油写歌词——！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 没有，完全没有。今天的演出，我也开心得不得了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 放在乐队里，说不定根本没人在意哦？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 这让我又一次感到，能组乐队、能玩音乐，真的太好了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 每天早上必须要看一下星座运势才行

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 下雨前的气味，我还挺喜欢的呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 积少成多！真是句好话呢！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 春天为什么会这么让人犯困呢……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_028
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 天气变暖和了，去野餐之类的可能也不错呢！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_000
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 晚上好，我们是millsage！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_001
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 晚上好，我们是millsage！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_002
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 嗯，拜拜！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_003
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: ……你好，小萤

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_004
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
哇～真是的，大家不用管我啦！
辛苦了，回见！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_005
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
这样啊……抱歉吓到你了吧。
这个视频最近在社交网站上挺火的

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_006
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 嗯。谢谢你

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_007
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 都说了对不起啦～！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_008
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 啊，不是的，不是这样！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_009
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 你是……视频里的那个女孩，对吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_010
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 啊，果然是有人擅自传上去的……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_011
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 所以我有些在意，就来看看你……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_012
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 但我认为，现在正是我们新的起点

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
那个……你经常在这里弹钢琴吗？
弹得特别好呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
你看，就是这个视频。
那个『神秘的超强街头钢琴少女』

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 她真的在弹……millsage的曲子……！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
这样啊。那可能最好找个懂这方面的人，
问问怎么申请删除比较好

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
啊，突然搭话真不好意思……我叫滨崎茉幌。
在水濑女子学园高中部读2年级哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 那、那个。其实我——

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
还称不上认识……只是前几天，
小萤弹钢琴的时候我过去搭了个话

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
不愧是小枣！
我也要加油写歌词——！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 没有，完全没有。今天的演出，我也开心得不得了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_022
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 放在乐队里，说不定根本没人在意哦？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_023
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 这让我又一次感到，能组乐队、能玩音乐，真的太好了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_024
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 每天早上必须要看一下星座运势才行

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_025
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 下雨前的气味，我还挺喜欢的呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_026
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 积少成多！真是句好话呢！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_027
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 春天为什么会这么让人犯困呢……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_028
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 天气变暖和了，去野餐之类的可能也不错呢！
